entitySuffixRule: Must contain the words "limited liability company" or "limited company," or the abbreviation "L.L.C.," "LLC," "L.C.," or "LC." "Limited" may be abbreviated as "Ltd." and "company" as "Co." The name may not contain "association," "corporation," "incorporated," "partnership," "limited partnership," or "L.P."
distinguishabilityNote: Must be distinguishable, on the records of the Division of Corporations and Commercial Code, from the actual name, reserved name, or assumed/fictitious name of any entity registered with the Division, and from any tradename, trademark, or service mark registered with the Division. The statutory test is that a distinguishable name contains one or more different words, letters, or numerals. Entity-type words and abbreviations, the articles "the," "and" and "a," punctuation and special characters, capitalization, and singular versus plural forms are all disregarded. Two exceptions: the holder of the conflicting name consents in writing and submits an undertaking to change its own name, or the applicant delivers a certified copy of a court judgment establishing its right to the name.
nameReservationCostBasis: The $22 Division of Corporations fee is the full cost of a name reservation.
notes: Restricted words need written consent before the Division will register the name: bank and related terms (Bank, Banker, Banking, Banc, Banque, Banco, Bancorp, Bancorporation, Bankcard, Bancard, Savings Association, Building Association, Savings and Loan Assoc.) require the Department of Financial Institutions; "university," "college," and "institute" require the Division of Consumer Protection under § 53B-5-114; and "Olympic," "Olympiad" and "Citius Altius Fortius" require the written consent of the United States Olympic Committee. Separately, § 48-3a-108 bars the number sequence "911" outright for any LLC formed or renamed on or after May 4, 2022, and bars "association," "corporation," "incorporated," "partnership," "limited partnership" and "L.P." from an LLC name. "Business trust" must appear as the last words of the name. A name reservation lasts 120 days and can be transferred by signed notice. Note: Utah reorganized its unincorporated-entity code effective 2026-10-01 (Chapter 93, 2026 General Session renumbers Title 48, Chapter 3a to Title 16, Chapter 20), so re-verify the section numbers after that date; the requirements above are current as of 2026-07-25.
